notes: Company background: mid-market SaaS that provides omnichannel support console used by customer success + support teams.
Primary goal: replace current cloud LLM vendor for chat agents — improve latency and reduce token costs while keeping streaming intact.
Workload details: live support agents open sessions with end users; streaming responses required for agent UX; tool calling to query ticket DB and run sentiment scoring.
Latency SLO: first-token <1.5s at 95th under expected load. VP Product: "we can’t have pauses in the agent stream — <1.5s is dealbreaker".
Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to lower-cost variant if region capacity constrained; also need model pinning for sensitive topics.
POC metrics: measure 50th/95th/99th first-token latencies, per-route token cost, streaming stability (connection drops), and tool call round-trip time.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs for each request, KMS integration for keys, and SOC2 compliance evidence. Data residency question — EU subset for GDPR customers.
Integration: target connectors: Zendesk + internal ticket system (REST), also plan for function/tool calling to fetch customer context.
Quote from CTO on call: "If Redwood can show predictable latency under our traffic and a migration path to Dedicated for stable pricing, we’ll run pilots across 4 teams."
